table.retrieve:
SELECT itemname= item.name,
			dbo.users.username,
			dbo.srledger.srinvcode,   
			dbo.srledger.saleinvcode, 
         dbo.srledger.date,   
         dbo.srledger.discperc,   
         dbo.srledger.misccharges,   
         dbo.srledger.flatdisc,   
         dbo.srledger.salestax,   
         dbo.srledger.remarks,   
         looseqty = dbo.srdetail.looseqty,   
         packqty  = dbo.srdetail.packqty,  
         icode = dbo.srdetail.icode,   
         srprice = dbo.srdetail.srprice,   
         discperc = dbo.srdetail.discperc ,
			unitsalestax=srdetail.unitsalestax,
			itemgstperc=srdetail.gstperc,
			invgstperc=srledger.invgstperc1,
			headerno=srledger.headerno,
			headerinvno=srledger.headerinvno,
			patient=(select name from patient where patientcode=srledger.patientcode),
			regno=(select regno from patient where patientcode=srledger.patientcode)

    FROM dbo.srledger,   
         dbo.srdetail,  
         dbo.item,
			dbo.users 

   WHERE ( dbo.srledger.srinvcode = :ra_InvCode ) AND 
			( dbo.srledger.srinvcode = dbo.srdetail.srinvcode) AND 
			( dbo.srledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode) AND 
			( srdetail.icode = item.icode ) 
	ORDER BY rowid

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: Round(sum( c_amount ) * (1 -  srledger_discperc  * .01) -  srledger_flatdisc  +  srledger_misccharges  +  srledger_salestax , 0)  + Round(Round( (Round( sum (c_amount for all) * (1 - 0.01 *  srledger_discperc ) ,2) -  srledger_flatdisc ) * 0.01 *  invgstperc  ,2 )  + sum( c_salestaxval for all) ,0)

objects.name: c_sumitemleveltaxval
objects.expression: sum(Round( unitsalestax  *  looseqty  +  (c_amount *  itemgstperc * 0.01) ,2) for all)

objects.name: compute_4
objects.expression: Round( (Round( sum (c_amount for all) * (1 - 0.01 *  srledger_discperc ) ,2) -  srledger_flatdisc ) * 0.01 *  invgstperc  ,2 )

objects.name: c_totalsalestax
objects.expression: Round( (sum (c_amount for all) * 0.01 *  srledger_discperc) * ( 1 -  srledger_flatdisc ) * (invgstperc  *  0.01) ,2)  + Round(sum( c_salestaxval for all) ,0)
